title: POC design and verification defaults
description: Overrideable defaults that keep experimental delivery proportionate.

defaults.title: Use the smallest design that supports a decision
defaults.statement: Document material boundaries, dependencies, data flow, failure behavior, and trade-offs without creating artifacts that do not support a delivery decision.
defaults.rationale: A bounded experiment needs sufficient clarity without unnecessary ceremony.

defaults.title: Use proportionate automated and manual evidence
defaults.statement: Automate core domain, persistence, and critical interaction behavior, then manually walk through the approved acceptance criteria.
defaults.rationale: The POC remains lightweight while preserving repeatable evidence for core behavior.

defaults.title: Use a qualitative POC performance boundary
defaults.statement: Unless the hypothesis depends on a measurable threshold, normal POC interactions must show no obvious lag during verification.
defaults.rationale: A numeric target is needed only when performance materially affects the product decision.
